upstream.description: The free build of Claude Code. All telemetry removed, security-prompt guardrails stripped, all experimental features enabled.

classification.analysis: free-code is a community rebuild of Anthropic's Claude Code CLI from a leaked source map, distributed as a buildable Bun/TypeScript project with all telemetry (OpenTelemetry, GrowthBook reporting, Sentry) stripped, Anthropic's injected security-prompt guardrails removed, and most of the 88 compile-time experimental feature flags unlocked (ultraplan, ultrathink, voice mode, IDE bridge, agent triggers, etc.). It supports the same multi-provider auth as upstream (Anthropic direct, OpenAI Codex, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Anthropic Foundry) and is aimed at developers who want an unrestricted, privacy-stripped terminal coding agent. It carries clear provenance and licensing concerns since it repackages Anthropic's proprietary CLI source.

use_cases.title: Run a telemetry-free build of a Claude Code-style terminal agent
Unlock experimental Claude Code feature flags like ultrathink or voice mode
Switch a Claude-Code-like CLI between Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex, or Codex backends
Inspect the internal architecture of a Claude Code-style CLI (tools, commands, bridge)
